verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly documents non-interactive scripting support, with `--output-format json` and `--output-format stream-json` flags for structured output suitable for automation pipelines, plus a dedicated bullet point calling out this exact use case. This is corroborated by GitHub Actions integrations (PR review, issue triage) that run the CLI non-interactively in CI workflows. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on validation of scripted/non-interactive mode specifically (community feedback focuses mostly on interactive agentic use).
